name: Neunkirchen (Siegerland, Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, black and yellow in the proportions 1:3:1, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Neunkirchen (black lozenges on yellow).
history: On 28 October 1969 the municipality was most recently granted the right to bear arms, a seal and a banner by the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg; the banner shows the arms shifted above the centre on a black stripe accompanied by two yellow side stripes in the ratio 1:3:1.

features.role: Neunkirchen arms — black lozenges on yellow
